release-bot: Deploy window for model-router v4.0.0 starting now. Feature flag plan: `model.route.v4.split` 0% -> 2% -> 10% over 25m. Change window 04:00-06:00 UTC. Paging @nina @omar for monitoring.

nina: ack. I'll watch p50/p95, 5xx, and routing success ratio. runbook: https://internal.redwood/releases/model-router/v4.0.0/runbook

omar: propose emergency-pin rules: auto-pin if 5xx > 1.5% for 4m OR p95 +250ms. Pin target v3.9.7. Also recommend starting at 1% not 2%.

release-bot: Plan adjusted: start 1% -> 2% hold -> 10%. Auto-pin conditions noted.

ops-bot: preflight OK: infra healthy, GPU headroom 29%, db lag 0.25s. Alerts armed to DM @omar on sustained errors.

nina: toggling to 1% now:
```
/redwood flag set --name model.route.v4.split --pct 1 --who nina --note "step1 gentle"
```

lucas: running a short eval against recent prompts; will flag semantic regressions.

nina: metrics after 7m: p95 baseline 210ms -> 225ms, 5xx 0.4% -> 0.5%. holding.

release-bot: advancing to 2% as scheduled.

nina: at 04:22 saw 5xx jump to 1.8% for ~3m, paging @omar.

omar: investigating traces t-510 and t-512, looks like a downstream cache write race. I triggered manual pin to v3.9.7 to stop ramp:
```
/release pin --service model-router --version v3.9.7 --who omar --reason "error spike during ramp"
```

release-bot: Manual pin recorded at 8600000059 by omar. Rolling back cohorts to v3.9.7 and draining v4.0.0 nodes. Posting rollback note to #release-notes: "v4.0.0 ramp paused due to elevated 5xx; pinned to v3.9.7 while infra investigates."

ops-bot: recommend hold on reattempt until cache race is fixed and a 24h staging soak. Also propose next ramp: 0.5% -> 2% -> 8% with quant shard disabled until 2%.

nina: agreed. updating release ticket and marking follow-up. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
